caveats: Static file-level reachability over-approximates executable paths; it is not behavioral evidence.
Catalog is the isolated audit database, not a new production snapshot.
SQL-to-SQL calls, triggers, indirect JavaScript RPC names, mobile direct calls, edge code and entrypoints outside API routes require MAP-01 review.
Unreached services may be called by pages, scripts, jobs or other entrypoints; absence is not dead-code evidence.
Area assignments are scheduling buckets, not completion claims.
